create_AudioGoalPredictor: create an AudioGoalPredictor module that predicts audio goal location using a pretrained ResNet18
run_AudioGoalPredictor_forward: run the AudioGoalPredictor forward pass on spectrogram input to predict audio goal features
update_AudioGoalPredictor: update AudioGoalPredictor observations with estimated agent location in egocentric and global coordinate frames
test_AudioGoalPredictor_predict_location: test AudioGoalPredictor with predict_location enabled to predict coordinates from spectrogram input
review_AudioGoalPredictor_update: review the AudioGoalPredictor update method that transforms coordinates between egocentric and global frames
